X-T15-009.title: Merging t-digest, singleton quantiles and observed error limits

environment.language: ISO C17, exact-width integers and double with at least 53 significand bits
environment.target: Hosted Linux numerical experiments; no target runtime or physical claim
environment.dependencies: Original allocation-free centroid, scale and interpolation mechanism. No third-party t-digest or math implementation. Hosted stdio/Python are verification support.

passages: Sections 2.1-2.3, PDF pages 4-5: centroid weight/mean, ordering and size invariant
Algorithm 1, PDF page 9: sorted centroid/raw-point merging construction
Section 2.8 equation 8, PDF page 12: normalized k2 scale
Section 2.9, PDF pages 13-15: interpolation and singleton behavior
Sections 1, 2.1 and 2.3, PDF pages 1-3: singleton-or-size invariant, added left/right weight and normalized k2 preservation

limitations: The real-arithmetic k-size invariant is not a universal quantile-error bound.
Large finite error, merge-order variation and cross-arithmetic divergence must be retained.
Author execution supplies neither delayed learner evidence nor physical observation.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Derive and implement bounded normalized-k2 centroid construction, checked staging and precisely defined singleton CDF/quantile behavior.
objective_coverage.scope: Required centroid quantile refinement; other parent algorithm mechanisms remain separately required.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Separate size-invariant, arithmetic, ordering and empirical-error claims; account for actual staging, sorting and validation cost.
objective_coverage.scope: Required centroid quantile refinement; other parent algorithm mechanisms remain separately required.

objective_coverage.assessed_claim: Use independent construction, mixture and exact raw-rank checks; implement and assess partition merging and coarser two-level recompression under changed orders.
objective_coverage.scope: Required centroid quantile refinement; other parent algorithm mechanisms remain separately required.

rubric.criterion: Derive and implement bounded normalized-k2 centroid construction, checked staging and precisely defined singleton CDF/quantile behavior.

levels.0: Missing mechanism or false deterministic/accuracy claim.
levels.1: Selected examples work but a required boundary, premise or independent check is absent.
levels.2: Derive and implement bounded normalized-k2 centroid construction, checked staging and precisely defined singleton CDF/quantile behavior. D1-D3 establish the stated finite contract and preserve unfavorable observations.
levels.3: Unaided D4 changes merge/compression conditions and defends the altered invariant, error and cost analysis.
